say: Wallets, research and scam defence.
This is the video for module 2 of Blockchain and Digital Assets Literacy.
Coins do not sit inside your phone. A wallet stores your private key, the secret that lets you sign a payment.

say: Most wallets make your keys from a recovery phrase of 12 or 24 ordinary words. A stranger with those words does not need your phone, your PIN or your face.

say: On an exchange, a company holds your keys. It is convenient, but exchanges have failed. FTX collapsed in November 2022, and customers could not withdraw.

panel.heading: Exchange account or your own wallet

say: In a self-custody wallet, you hold the keys. No company can freeze it, but if you lose or reveal your phrase, nobody can help.
While you are learning, keep only what you are prepared to lose completely.

say: Payments cannot be reversed, so scammers love crypto. The first scam is seed-phrase phishing. The tell is any request for your phrase.

cards.d: Fake support or a fake sync site asks for your recovery phrase.
Profits grow on screen, then you must pay a fee to withdraw.
A buyer sends a fake bank alert. Check your bank app before you release.

say: The second is a fake trading platform. The early profit is bait. If you must pay a tax or unlock fee to withdraw, the profits were never real.

cards.d: Fake support or a fake sync site asks for your recovery phrase.
Profits grow on screen, then you must pay a fee to withdraw.
A buyer sends a fake bank alert. Check your bank app before you release.

say: The third is P2P payment fraud. Never trust an SMS alert or a screenshot. Open your own bank app and check the naira has landed before you release anything.

say: For example, Grace is added to a Telegram group promising 40% every month. She checks the maths first.
She has 200,000 naira. After month 1, that would be 280,000 naira.
Over 12 months, that compounds to about 11,340,000 naira. About 57 times her money in one year.
No honest business delivers that. If it were real, they would not need her 200,000 naira.
If you shared your phrase or signed a bad approval, act in this order. First, create a brand-new wallet with a new phrase on a clean device.

say: To remember. Your phrase is everything. Keep it on paper, never digital, never shared. Send a small test first. A fee to withdraw means the profits were never real. And recovery agents are a second scam.
